name: fi.broc/broc-mcp
title: Broc — Clara & Clive Financial Assistant
description: Audit bank CSV statements, map Sankey cash flows & compare Irish broadband, energy & savings deals.

tools.name: analyze_bank_csv
tools.description: Parses and audits bank CSV statements (Revolut, AIB, Bank of Ireland, PTSB, N26, Bunq, Monzo, Nationwide, generic CSVs). ULTRA-FAST MODE FOR >120 ROWS: Group by (Month YYYY-MM-15, Description WITH original "To "/"Transfer to "/"Payment from " prefix intact, +/-, Type) into a ~40-90 line 5-column `Date,Description,Amount,Count,Type` CSV (keeping single items >=1000 as Count=1 — NEVER collapse multiple months into 1 undated row per merchant!) AND pass `statementStartDate` (exact earliest YYYY-MM-DD in raw CSV), `statementEndDate` (exact latest YYYY-MM-DD in raw CSV), `closingBalanceEur`, and `accountHolderName` (if known). Include ALL external salary/SEPA credits (+Amount, including Revolut Type="TOPUP" employer payroll like Optum); exclude only REVERTED/FAILED/DECLINED/PENDING, EXCHANGE, crypto/Revolut Digital Assets, Pocket/Vault moves, and card/own-bank self top-ups.

csvText.description: CSV statement text. For >120 rows, pass a monthly-grouped 5-column "Date,Description,Amount,Count,Type" (or 4-column "Date,Description,Amount,Count") CSV keeping "To "/"Transfer to "/"Payment from " prefixes intact.

statementStartDate.description: Exact earliest transaction date (YYYY-MM-DD) in the raw CSV statement. REQUIRED whenever passing grouped CSV rows so Clara normalizes monthly spend over the exact statement window (e.g. 3.75 months).

statementEndDate.description: Exact latest transaction date (YYYY-MM-DD) in the raw CSV statement. REQUIRED whenever passing grouped CSV rows so Clara normalizes monthly spend over the exact statement window.

accountHolderName.description: Optional account holder first or full name (if known from user context or statement header) so transfers to the user’s own external accounts (e.g. "To <OwnName>") are automatically excluded from expenses.

closingBalanceEur.description: Optional latest closing account balance in EUR (use when emitting compact/grouped CSV rows without a Balance column).

csvBase64.description: Optional base64-encoded CSV file bytes (handles UTF-8, UTF-16, and Windows-1252 bank exports).

csvUrl.description: Optional HTTPS URL to a CSV attachment or signed download link.

csvFiles.description: Optional array of multiple CSV statements (e.g. Current Account + Credit Card) to merge and analyze together.

sessionId.description: Optional label within your isolated connection session (defaults to "default") for follow-up ledger queries or Sankey diagrams.

appendToExistingSession.description: Set true to combine this CSV (or CSV chunk) with statements already loaded in your current session.

tools.name: get_sample_spending_analysis
tools.description: Returns Clara’s realistic sample Irish household bank statement audit (Revolut EUR statement with category drilldowns, 50/30/20 split, overlapping streaming audit, and €2,880/yr in savings levers) plus an explanation of Broc’s purpose and interactive dashboard widget.

tools.name: get_cash_flow_sankey
tools.description: Generates Clara’s normalized monthly Sankey Cash Flow Map (Income Sources -> Account Hub -> Expense Categories & Net Surplus), returning BOTH Broc’s interactive MCP App UI widget (`ui://broc/sankey-cashflow.html`) AND structured `nodes`/`links` flow data. If your host renders Artifacts/SVG natively instead of MCP App iframes, draw Clara’s visual Sankey chart directly from `structuredContent.sankey` as Clara’s Cash Flow Map (never tell the user Broc only returns a table). IMPORTANT: After calling `analyze_bank_csv`, DO NOT pass `csvText` here — pass `{}` or `sessionId` only.

sessionId.description: Session ID from a previous analyze_bank_csv call on this connection (defaults to "default"; falls back to sample data if none loaded).

csvText.description: Optional CSV text ONLY when calling get_cash_flow_sankey standalone without analyze_bank_csv. Omit whenever analyze_bank_csv was called.

csvUrl.description: Optional HTTPS URL to a CSV attachment.

fileName.description: Optional filename hint when passing CSV data directly.

tools.name: query_imported_transactions
tools.description: Queries individual cleaned transactions from your isolated bank CSV session by category (e.g. dining, utilities, subscriptions, groceries), merchant name, free-text search, amount range, or ISO date range.

sessionId.description: Session ID within your connection (defaults to "default").

type.description: Filter by expense, income, or all (default).

search.description: Free-text search across merchant, raw bank narrative, and category.

startDate.description: Start date inclusive in YYYY-MM-DD format.

endDate.description: End date inclusive in YYYY-MM-DD format.

tools.name: clear_statement_session
tools.description: Immediately wipes cached CSV transactions and audit state for your session from memory.

tools.name: compare_prices
tools.description: Benchmarks Irish household bills, financial products, and subscriptions across Broadband, Electricity, Natural Gas, Dual-Fuel Energy, Mobile SIM-Only, High-Yield Savings Accounts (incl. 33% Irish DIRT net yield math), Insurance, and Streaming — calculating monthly/annual EUR savings, Top Pick rationale, switching checklist, and rendering Clive’s interactive comparison widget.

query.description: What to compare (e.g. "1Gb fibre broadband", "electricity EV night rate", "SIM-only 5G", "instant access savings for €15,000", "home insurance", "streaming overlap").

currentProvider.description: Optional user’s current provider (e.g. "Virgin Media", "Electric Ireland", "AIB") so Clive prioritises new-customer switchers.

currentMonthlySpend.description: Optional user’s current monthly spend in EUR (e.g. from analyze_bank_csv) to calculate exact euro savings.

depositBalanceEur.description: For category="savings": deposit balance in EUR to model gross & post-DIRT interest (default €10,000).

currentAerPct.description: For category="savings": current gross AER % earned on the user’s cash (default 0.25%).

preferences.description: Optional preferences such as "no contract", "EV night boost", "1Gb SIRO", "instant access", "Vodafone network".

tools.name: list_price_compare_categories
tools.description: Lists all Irish bill, utility, deposit, insurance, and subscription categories supported by Clive’s Help Me Shop engine alongside typical out-of-contract monthly benchmarks.

tools.name: list_blog_posts
tools.description: Lists published articles from the Broc Blog (blog.broc.fi) covering Irish consumer rights, eliminating loyalty penalties on broadband & energy, utility switching, DIRT & savings yields, and how Clara & Clive work.

query.description: Optional keyword search across article titles, summaries, and full text.

tag.description: Optional category/tag filter (e.g. "Consumer Rights", "Energy Savings", "AI Architecture", "Productivity").

limit.description: Maximum number of posts to return (default 10).

tools.name: get_blog_post
tools.description: Retrieves the full Markdown article content for a specific Broc Blog post by slug or title.

slugOrTitle.description: Article slug (from list_blog_posts) or title substring.

tools.name: get_broc_docs
tools.description: Retrieves Broc platform documentation explaining Broc’s purpose ("Where financial noise becomes peace"), Clara & Clive AI capabilities, Open Banking security (Yapily) & EU GDPR privacy policy, Terms of Service, Financial Disclaimer, founders, and verified platform links.

topic.description: Topic ID or search query: "overview", "ai-team", "pricing", "security-gdpr", "terms-disclaimer", "team-links", "llms-full", "all", or any free-text question (e.g. "what is Broc", "Yapily security", "GDPR data residency", "who founded Broc").
